messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC; the old Tuesday 13:00-15:00 UTC window is retired. [constraint; valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19]
    earlier: Deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-06 to 2025-08-19; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06]
- The Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node. [decision; valid 2025-06-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-06-06]
- From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- On 2026-05-22, team Dune reported that the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-3]
- On 2026-05-28, the Ember team noticed that the ledger service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-28]
- On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover document for Lena. [valid 2025-06-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01-2]
- As of 2026-01-30, the Cinder team agreed that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, because the security audit flagged long-lived tokens. [decision; valid 2026-01-30 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-30]
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- Certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, a follow-up decision from the INC-2025-017 review. [decision; valid 2025-08-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- On 2026-04-14, team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- INC-2025-011 was a ledger service incident on 2025-05-24. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The ledger service has a deploy freeze from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 because of the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-11]

Question: Which note records the decision that the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, and when was it written?

message.reasoning:

From memory: "The job scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, a decision from the INC-2026-009 review. [decision; valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]"

So the note is incident-review/INC-2026-009, recorded/valid from 2026-05-19.

Answer should be short: incident-review/INC-2026-009, 2026-05-19.
